title: Restaurant serving beer and wine in Fairfax County (Annandale)

input.what: Korean restaurant serving beer and wine

assumptions: An existing Virginia LLC. Hires staff. Builds out. No new sign. Serves beer and wine, no spirits.

items.name: Employer Identification Number (EIN)
items.note: IRS: "You never have to pay a fee for an EIN."

items.name: Business tax registration (sales and use tax, withholding)
items.match: virginia business tax registration|sales and use tax|va-tax|business registration
items.note: The library's page; not re-read for this case.

items.name: Unemployment insurance employer registration
items.note: The library's page; not re-read for this case.

items.name: Certified food protection manager
items.quote: A food manager must be present with an accredited exam certificate.

items.name: Business, Professional and Occupational License (BPOL)
items.agency: Fairfax County Department of Tax Administration
items.quote: All businesses with a physical location in Fairfax County — including home-based businesses — must have a business license

items.name: Food establishment plan review
items.quote: Construction of the food establishment cannot begin until the Health Department has completed its commercial plan review process.

items.name: Permit to operate a food establishment
items.match: (permit to operate|food establishment permit).*(fairfax)|(fairfax).*(permit to operate|food establishment permit)
items.quote: must get a Permit to Operate a Food Establishment from Fairfax County Health Department.

items.name: Retail license for on-premises wine and beer
items.quote: If any person who is not licensed sells any alcoholic beverages except as permitted by this subtitle, he shall be guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor.

items.name: Alcohol dealer registration (TTB F 5630.5d)
items.agency: Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau
items.note: "No person may engage in the business of selling or offering to sell distilled spirits, wine, or beer without first registering." Before engaging in business; no fee stated.

order.why: Plan review before construction; the permit after the pre-occupancy inspection.

mustNotInclude.name: California or New York alcohol steps
mustNotInclude.match: state liquor authority|california department of alcoholic|conditional use permit to sell alcohol|community board
